name: Teachers Pay Teachers listing migration utility
buyer: Small teacher-sellers of worksheets and units who want to relist products outside TPT
pain: High platform cuts, sudden account closures with withheld earnings, and no ownership of the customer relationship.
wedge: A migration utility that takes TPT product files and covers and relists them on Payhip or Stripe, with SEO-optimised titles and an automatic bundle builder.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: Sellers relist on Payhip at a 5% per-sale fee (C19). The 45% TPT take is derived from the 55% royalty (inference). The 5% is Payhip's fee, not the entrant's own advantage.
scan1Edge.falsifier: Sellers can already relist manually on Payhip. If the tool saves little time or sellers lack discovery off TPT, nobody pays. Average sellers earn under $100/month.
scan1Edge.unit: percent of sale revenue taken by platform

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: Model: the notes estimate about 85% gross margin, but no price is specified. Willingness to pay is low because sellers earn little.

majorUncertainty: Whether sellers earning under $100/month will pay for a migration tool when the real problem is discovery.
unknowns: The 2 hours versus 10 hours relisting time (estimate only)
TPT terms on exporting or relisting content
Payhip fee conflict (the notes mention an 85% revenue-share snippet)
How an unknown entrant would reach sellers
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Depends on access to TPT product files and on Payhip or Stripe. Copyright and ownership issues are widespread. There is no discovery without TPT's marketplace.

evidence.publisher: The Best Etsy Alternative for Teachers: Selling on TPT (2026 Guide)
evidence.shows: TPT pays a 55% royalty on the free Basic account, or 80% on Premium with an annual fee.
evidence.quote: TPT: 55% royalty (free Basic account) or 80% royalty (Premium seller account, annual fee).

evidence.publisher: Teachers Pay Teachers Alternatives: Top Sites & Tips
evidence.shows: Payhip charges a 5% per-sale fee with no monthly costs, which is an alternative the utility would target.
evidence.quote: Payhip charges only a 5% per-sale fee with no monthly costs, so you keep 95% of your earnings.

evidence.shows: A Trustpilot seller reports TPT suspended and closed the account without warning and withheld $300 of earnings.
